lines.zh: 我拖着步子往前，肩一高一低。
lines.en: I shamble forward, one shoulder low.
I come out gripping a wooden club.
I tread the grass and break it.
I walk slowly your way.
I go around the stone, grudgingly.
I curse as I walk.

lines.zh: 我走两步就停下来看你。
lines.en: Two steps, then I stop to stare at you.

lines.zh: 我从坡上下来，脚下打滑。
lines.en: I come down the slope and slip.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的东西踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick what you dropped aside.

lines.zh: 我扛着个袋子，走得很沉。
lines.en: I carry a sack, heavily.
I close in step by step, unhurried.
I edge along the wall, avoiding the front.
I sit and gnaw a carrot.
I twirl the club in my hand.
I'm picking my nose; it's ugly.
I weigh the iron ingot.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有同伙在喊。
lines.en: I hear kin shouting far off.

lines.zh: 我挠了挠脏兮兮的肚皮。
lines.en: I scratch my grubby belly.
I spit on the ground.

lines.zh: 我把袋子里的东西倒出来看。
lines.en: I tip the sack out to look.
I'm counting today's take.
I lean on the stone to rest.
You see this club?
Your things look good.
Alone? Even better.

lines.zh: 我这肩膀，扛过整袋石头。
lines.en: These shoulders have hauled sacks of stone.
Going to run? Go on then.
I've had my eye on you a while.
That in your hand; give it.
I hate people who stand up straight.
You're not so tall yourself.

lines.zh: 我牙不太好，但棒子好用。
lines.en: My teeth aren't much, but the club works.
I swear and back off two steps.
I double over and take a while to rise.
My sack hits the ground.

lines.zh: 我龇着牙，眼泪都出来了。
lines.en: I bare my teeth, my eyes watering.
I lick the corner of my mouth; it tastes of iron.
I screech, and it's ugly.
I grip the club harder.
I hop back on one leg.
I spit blood.
I get up and spit on the ground.
That iron; give it.
You've got food, haven't you?
Set the bag down and I won't hit you.
I like shiny things.
That string of things at your waist is nice.

lines.zh: 那袋子里有麦子的味儿。
lines.en: There's a wheat smell in that bag.
Hand it over and I won't have to take it.
I take one step closer.
Your boots look wearable.

lines.zh: 再拿出来一点，让我看看。
lines.en: Show a little more, let me see.
You bump me; I bump back.
I step back and raise the club.

lines.zh: 我们撞上，我的袋子掉了。
lines.en: We collide, and my sack falls.
You're taller; I don't accept it.
You shove me down on my backside.
I turn and shoulder you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚趾，我骂了一句。
lines.en: You step on my toe; I swear.

lines.zh: 我抓着你的腰带往后拽。
lines.en: I grab your belt and haul backward.

lines.zh: 我一头磕在石头上，眼冒金星。
lines.en: I crack my head on stone and see stars.

lines.zh: 我们分开，我马上找棒子。
lines.en: We part, and I reach for my club.
Another peon squats over there.
She snatches things faster than I do.
We split a carrot.
She curses me; I curse back.
We crouch and watch the road together.
Her club is thicker than mine.

lines.zh: 她把抢来的东西扔给我。
lines.en: She tosses me some of the loot.
We push that door together.
Her ear is missing a corner.
Two of us, one carrot.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块铁，塞进袋子。
lines.en: I pick up iron and stuff it in the sack.

lines.zh: 我把你的剑捡起来，太重。
lines.en: I pick up your sword; too heavy.

lines.zh: 我把那半块面包塞进袋。
lines.en: I stuff the half loaf into my sack.
I drag your shield two paces.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚硬币，咬了咬。
lines.en: I pick up a coin and bite it.

lines.zh: 我把地上的果子塞嘴里。
lines.en: I stuff the fallen fruit in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块布，缠在手上。
lines.en: I pick up a cloth and wrap my hand.
I gather the arrows one by one.
I take your hat and put it on.
I drag off the whole bag.
You're carrying too much.
I see you, and you're alone.
I'm coming; don't run.
I've raised the club.

lines.zh: 你把我的沟踩塌了一边。
lines.en: You've caved in one side of my ditch.
This patch answers to us.
I want those boots.

lines.zh: 我数了三下，你也听见了。
lines.en: I counted three; you heard it.
I cut you off on this side.
I look up and see your face.
My kin will be here soon.
Your pockets jingle; you can't hide them.
I'll start; no need to wait.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛看着我不舒服。
lines.en: The way you look at me is unpleasant.
This ditch is one I walk every day.
Leave the bag and go.

lines.zh: 我咧开嘴，让你看清我的牙。
lines.en: I grin so you can see every tooth.
I don't do fair.

lines.zh: 我蹭着地面一步一步凑。
lines.en: I shuffle closer, step by step.
You shift left; so do I.
I raise the club to my shoulder.
I crouch, ready to charge.
Your back's against the stone now.
I spit into my palm.
You switched hands; I heard.

lines.zh: 你脚下那块石头是松的。
lines.en: That stone under you is loose.
Below your shield's rim, your leg shows.
Two more steps.
I call out; my kin will come.
I tap the ground with the club.
I'm in no hurry; you can't outrun me.
My feet scuff the ground.
There's someone behind that stone.
I set the sack down to fight.
I creep along the wall to your flank.
There's a wall behind you.
My grin gets uglier.
One more step and I swing.
I bring the club down.
I ram you with my shoulder.
I grab your belt and pull.
I drive my knee into the back of your knee.

lines.zh: 棒子敲在铁上，震得手麻。
lines.en: My club rings on iron and numbs my hand.
I grab your hair.
I sweep the club sideways.
You block it; I add an elbow.
I shove you into a tree.
I stand on your foot.
I grip your shield's rim and wrench.

lines.zh: 这一下我自己也站不稳。
lines.en: That one nearly put me off balance too.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里那口烂泥喷你。
lines.en: I spit the mouthful of rotten mud at you.
You retreat; I chase two steps and stop.
I snatch the club up and swing again.
I'm laughing too hard to breathe.
I butt my forehead into your ribs.

lines.zh: 我用脏指甲抠你的眼睛。
lines.en: I claw at your eyes with filthy nails.
I swing the sack at you.
I pin your hand until it lets go.
I come out from behind the stone.

lines.zh: 我扛着袋子，先看看四周。
lines.en: I carry a sack and look around first.
Things here are worth taking.

lines.zh: 我把棒子在地上敲了两下。
lines.en: I knock the club on the ground twice.
My kin said someone's around here.
The plains are empty.
First I sit and rest a while.
Iron smell — my nose twitches.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上数我的家当。
lines.en: I squat on a rock counting my loot.
I check my teeth; still there.
I head toward where people are.
I swear once and stand up.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袋子，我拍打着。
lines.en: Fire catches my sack; I beat at it.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，摔得头晕。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, dazed.

lines.zh: 我抓着水草，喝了一肚子。
lines.en: I grab at weeds and swallow half the pond.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出去，袋子破了。
lines.en: The blast throws me, and my sack splits.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我腿上，我拔不掉。
lines.en: An arrow is stuck in my leg; I can't pull it.
The light falls, and my legs give.
I'm too hungry to curse.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning flashes; my ears ring.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有，抢不到。
lines.en: Nothing here to take.
